task_description: Compress a folder into a tar.gz archive.
Restart one of the web, database or cache services.
Download a file from a URL with curl.
Speak a message with a text-to-speech tool.
Run a database migration for an environment name (dev, staging, prod).
Open a firewall port given as a number.
Convert seconds to an hours:minutes:seconds string.
Return the disk-usage line for a given mount point.
Generate a PDF from an HTML file.
Set the system time zone to a zone name such as Europe/Paris.
